title: 8/12/26: Minor Heat Advisory Issued; Clear Evening With Temps Reaching 91.6, High Today 97.9, Low 75.4 - NewsBreak
text:
By Source Staff ,
4 hours ago Heat Advisory
* WHAT…Heat index values up to 109.
* WHERE…A portion of Middle Tennessee.
* WHEN…Until 7 PM CDT Sunday.
* IMPACTS…Hot temperatures and high humidity may cause heat illnesses.
From 2026-08-12T16:18:00+00:00 · until 2026-08-17T00:00:00+00:00 · Source: NWS Nashville TN
A Minor Heat Advisory is currently in effect for Maury County until 7 PM CDT Sunday.
As of 7:00 PM, the temperature in Maury County is 91.6°F with a light wind from the south at 6 mph and no recorded precipitation. The sky is clear, and earlier today, the high reached 97.9°F, while the low was 75.4°F.
Tonight, temperatures are expected to remain warm, with a low of 81.3°F. Winds may increase slightly, gusting up to 9.6 mph. The chance of precipitation is low at 8%, and clear skies are anticipated to continue into the evening.
The Minor Heat Advisory warns of heat index values reaching up to 109°F, indicating that hot temperatures combined with high humidity may pose a risk of heat illnesses. Residents are advised to take precautions if engaged in outdoor activities during this period.
